caseName: Public Service Commission v. Chesapeake & Potomac Telephone Co.
caseNameFull: Public Service Commission of Maryland v. Chesapeake & Potomac Telephone Company of Maryland

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 472 U. S. 1026.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.

Justice Powell and Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
